note: Shared owners render owner state and never hold a second truth. Consumers are the concept surfaces that mount each owner. window-01..08 and thread-c01..08 are the sixteen concepts; 'all' means every pairing.

entries.duplication_risk: a thread concept re-implementing the send/stop state machine or draft persistence
a window drawing its own route chips instead of hosting the shared instance
a concept computing its own context percentages — forbidden; Usage owns internals
per-concept lens semantics; only flags' visual form varies
renderer skinning is prohibited the other way around — shared STATE, distinct COMPOSITION is the required split

entries.shared_owner: GoalSummary / TodoGroup / SubagentGroup / DiffSummary state (store + workCluster)
entries.duplication_risk: a concept mutating goal/todo state locally instead of dispatching store commands
appending per-step cards instead of in-place rewrite
a window bypassing the floor/degrade rules
a window parsing artifact bodies itself
concept-local approval flows
class taxonomy drift
per-concept connection banners (forbidden)
concept-local timers diverging from the turn record
a second notification surface — receipts are inline outcomes, app-wide events stay in the title-bar stack

consumers: every menu, search result list, More Info, message ops, kebab, ring, spell menu
entries.duplication_risk: any second overlay system; one transient overlay is enforced in code

consumers: every scrollable surface incl. popup bodies and nested panels
entries.duplication_risk: native scrollbar leakage
per-concept search grammars; scope semantics must stay canonical

entries.shared_owner: MessageMetaRow content contract (labels + More Info fields)
entries.duplication_risk: adding Resend or message-level Stop; dropping mandated labels
inline colors or runtime mixing
retyped canon strings drifting from mandated wording

no_parallel_systems: No second manager, auth, usage, notification, progress, or install system exists anywhere in the folder (PROC-007).
